quests.title: A Small Overture

dialogue.t: ...So, how have the Frostmoon Scions been faring lately?
Quite well. The return of the Moon Goddess has strengthened our resolve to walk our given path.
Really? Well, that's good to hear.
Hah... I suppose we really do have nothing to talk about.
I'm afraid that... is because there's far too much history between the Frostmoon Scions and the Fatui.
Speaking purely for myself, I'm grateful for your efforts in protecting Nod-Krai and welcoming back the Moon Goddess, Miss Sandrone. But as for your associates...
I understand. For various reasons, we failed to establish friendly relations — or even mutually beneficial ones.
But the Fatui no longer seek to take anything from the Frostmoon Scions, and I have reminded my subordinates not to make things difficult.
From where I stand, seeing as we're neighbors, even if we can't coexist in perfect harmony, it would be nice if we could at least treat each other with mutual respect.
I'm afraid that will take time...
Undoubtedly. But we can start by taking one small step at a time. Would you like to try this herbal tea I prepared?
Oh? Herbal tea...?
Hmm... Such rich flavor. Did you brew this the Frostmoon Scions' way? Most outsiders I've met don't like our tea. How did you...
By learning. And showing respect.
Hah... Not a bad first step.
I hope it suits your tastes.
I like it a lot.
Amicable exchanges over hot pots of tea have always been a great way to strike up friendly relations.
I have a feeling this time will be no exception.
A truly delicious herbal tea, Miss Sandrone. It's like I can taste your sincerity.

dialogue.sit: (Let's sit like this for a little while longer.)
I think it's time I started clearing up.

dialogue.t: Alright. Next time, I'll have to invite you for tea.

quests.description: Go to the Frostmoon Enclave, place your tea table, and have Sandrone take a seat. Then, prepare to enjoy some tea with Lauma…
